title: Every kept model exchange says what thinking its request asked for
request: The owner, after the live HyperAck run: yes, make each saved model exchange record the thinking setting its request carried, so an empty thinking can be told apart from thinking never asked for.
spec: Owner's rule (rule 8 and ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md): every model call keeps its API thinking summary; reasoning only from summarized thinking blocks, never asked for in the reply text. A kept exchange with no thinking must say whether thinking was asked.
plan: Find where exchanges are written (Bound._keep_exchange) and its tests
Test first: asked and silent, off, shown cells, refused model, shadow
Record the setting on every line, served and shadow

decisions.decision: Record the setting the transport carried, not a guess from the reply
decisions.why: only the request knows what was asked; an empty reply cannot tell 'chose not to think' from 'never asked'

decisions.decision: Write it before the whole / shape-only branch
decisions.why: a purpose shown cell values keeps only its shape, and its line must still say whether thinking was asked

decisions.decision: A transport with no thinking setting gets its own value, not None
decisions.why: None means the setting was off; an OpenAI-style local client has no setting yet may return reasoning

decisions.decision: Never ask the model for reasoning in its reply to fill an empty thinking
decisions.why: the owner's rule: reasoning only from summarized thinking blocks; an empty result is kept as it is

change: dclab_rnd/models/gateway.py (_asked_of, TRANSPORT_DECIDES; Bound._keep_exchange writes thinking_asked on every line and thinking_dropped when the client sent the request without thinking; the shadow passes its own transport's setting), tests/test_thinking_everywhere.py (3 tests, 1 extended).

findings.defect: A kept exchange with thinking [] could not say whether thinking was asked
findings.scenario: live HyperAck run 2026-10-28 (agent_runs/live_tests/2026-10-28-rnd-hyperack-live): home_agent (1 call) and leakage_review (3 calls) on Claude Sonnet 5.5 kept thinking [] while stage_notes kept summaries
findings.cause: the line kept the reply's thinking but not the request's thinking setting
findings.fix: thinking_asked on every line: the served transport's setting, or the shadow's

findings.defect: A local model's line said 'never asked' while it held thinking
findings.scenario: a local Qwen tier (OpenAI-style ChatClient, no thinking attribute) serves or shadows a purpose and returns reasoning; the line had thinking_asked null and non-empty thinking
findings.cause: getattr(transport, 'thinking', None) gave None both for 'off' and for 'no such setting'
findings.fix: _asked_of: TRANSPORT_DECIDES for a transport with no thinking setting, None only when the setting is off or no transport was made

findings.defect: thinking_dropped could mark a call that did think
findings.scenario: two requests on one model at once; B is refused for thinking and marks the model in NO_THINKING_MODELS while A, sent with thinking, is out; A's line said 'sent without thinking' beside its thinking
findings.cause: the process-wide set was read when the line was written, not when the request was sent
findings.fix: thinking_dropped only when the reply has no thinking

measurements.name: related test files
measurements.gate: every test in the 12 files that read or write kept exchanges passes
limits: no live call was made after the change; the field is checked on scripted transports only

measurements.name: live HyperAck run that found it
measurements.gate: not scored: the run that showed kept lines with empty thinking
measurements.result: 20 calls, EUR 0.20; stage_notes 10/10 kept summaries, intern 2/6 thought (kept redacted), home_agent 0/1 and leakage_review 0/3 returned no thinking
limits: it cannot show whether thinking was asked on those calls: that is what this change records from now on

outcome: Every kept model exchange now says what thinking its request asked for (adaptive, off, or the transport decides), and says when the client had to send it without thinking, so an empty thinking is never mistaken for one never asked.
lessons: Record what was asked beside what came back: an empty answer alone cannot be read.
None should mean one thing; give 'no such setting' its own value.
A process-wide flag read at write time can mislabel a request that was already out; check it against the reply.
risks: Older lines have no thinking_asked; readers must treat a missing field as unknown.
One refusal still turns thinking off for a model for the whole process (older code); the label now makes it visible.
